result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked crosswalks and sidewalks on all corners. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the environment lacks advanced safety features such as pedestrian signals or curb extensions to improve visibility.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners may obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbside of the intersecting streets near the crosswalks.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings show signs of wear and fading, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and right side of the intersection.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to ensure they are clearly seen by drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks and paved sidewalks. However, the environment lacks active traffic control devices and contains significant visual obstructions from parked vehicles near the crossing points.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large trailer and parked cars are positioned immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, severely limiting sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground near the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks visible stop signs or signals to regulate vehicle priority at the marked pedestrian crossing.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility pedestrian crossing signs (W11-2) to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.
